SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.* , B.ORDERNO, C.ID AS PROJID, D.TESTMETHODTYPE, E.STDNAME, F.INDEXNAME, F.INDEX1, F.INDEX2,
OC.ORDERCONTAINERNO,
F.INDEX3 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_ITEM_GROUP A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER B ON A.ORDERID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT C ON B.PROJID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_METHOD D ON A.TESTMETHODID = D.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_INDEX_CATEGORY E ON A.INDEXCATEGORYID = E.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_INDEX F ON A.INDEXID = F.ID
LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT ON A.ORDERID = OT.ORDERID AND A.TESTMETHODID = OT.TESTMETHODID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_CONTAINER OC ON OT.ORDERCONTAINERID = OC.ID
) T
GROUP BY T.ID
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
